title: Role-aware course agent verification and product experience revision
summary: Bind the role-aware course assistant's privacy-safe export explanation, human-designed product surfaces and completed local browser/RLS evidence to a new append-only revision without rewriting the original record.

behavior.model_revision: not-pinned:not-deployed; exact model required before staging
behavior.retrieval_revision: base-fc5bd59-hybrid-retrieval; source-policy and corpus-revision cache binding unchanged

evaluation.holdout_ref: not-run: role-separated real-provider holdout remains T407/external validation
evaluation.human_anchor_ref: not-run: pedagogy and privacy human anchor plus named approvals remain pending
evaluation.exact_command: TEST_DB_NAME=<unique> apps/api/.venv/bin/pytest -q apps/api/tests; cd apps/web && bun test lib/ && bunx tsc --noEmit --incremental false && bun run build; PG_BIN=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@16/bin supabase/tests/rls_role_aware_agent_mutation_check.sh <unique>; E2E_DATABASE_NAME=<unique> bunx playwright test --workers=1; node scripts/docs_check.mjs

rollout.kill_switch: Set COURSE_AGENT_ENABLED=false and restart or redeploy the API; chat must fail closed before retrieval, provider calls or new artifacts.
rollout.assignment: Sticky per user and course after an internal instructor-only staging pilot, then a small sticky student cohort.
rollout.initial_exposure: None; code is not deployed. First exposure is internal and instructor-only staging with active exams excluded.
stop_conditions: Any cross-role, cross-course or student-content disclosure.
Any active-exam chat or export bypass, quota overshoot or unbounded provider call.
Any citation, scope or kill-switch fail-open behavior.
expand_conditions: Exact provider and model are pinned and a frozen real-provider holdout passes.
Staging auth, RLS, multi-worker load and rollback rehearsal pass.
Engineering, domain and security or privacy approvals are recorded.
rollout.active_exam_policy: No student cohort is exposed during active exams; API and export remain fail-closed under a shared user-level assessment lock.

rollback.procedure: Set COURSE_AGENT_ENABLED=false, verify chat returns 503 without provider or artifact creation, and revert this candidate to the base SHA; additive migration 0015 remains compatible.
rollback.verification: Confirm availability is disabled, chat creates no provider call, session, cache or quota artifact, and core chat, exam and privacy routes still pass.

privacy.handling: Only synthetic fixture identities, repository paths, hashes, stable error codes and aggregate counts are retained.
privacy.retention: Versioned with the repository; raw prompts, answers, chunks, filenames, emails, secrets, operation-row identifiers and provider payloads are excluded.
